style: Avant-garde global art-rock fusion with 1/3-comma meantone microtonal tuning. Harmony uses quartal suspended fields and aggressive modal drone roots. Melody deploys ornamented nadaswaram calls, zampoña breathy hockets, and Yoruba lexical tone pressure with aggressive ejective attacks. Rhythm builds on a 3:2 polyrhythmic coupling, nested tuplets, stomp/floor resonance, and dry handclap grids. Timbre features dry hammered santur, udu clay bass, darbouka, shekere, berimbau, and an indifferent refrigerator compressor drone. Vocals are aggressively cheerful speech-song with Navajo glottal stops and contrastive vowel lengths. Performance is theatrical, hyper-kinetic, and communal. Production uses public-access television room capture, multigeneneration copy loss, disc skips, and radio telescope telemetry.
lyrics:
[Intro: Radio Telescope Intercept and Refrigerator Compressor Drone]
[Transmission: Public-Access TV Studio Live Switcher Active]
[Anchor Motif Begins: Santur Tremolo in 1/3-Comma Meantone]
[Stomp / Floor Resonance Pulse Enters with 3:2 Polyrhythm]

[Verse 1: Aggressively Cheerful Confuddlement]
Cosmic revelation is arriving right on time!
(Joy and laughter! Joy and laughter!) [Navajo Glottal Stop Punctuation on Stops]
Rainbow sparkles! Rainbow sparkles! Every single line!
Unicorn farts are ascending through the stratosphere!
We are classifying this as meteorological gear!
[Clipboard State Check: Item 409 Checked Off]
[Ejective Attack on 'Stratosphere' — Obsessive Pressure]
[Internal Diagnostic: Core temperature nominal, pressure gauges stabilizing within standard parameters]
[Operator Instruction: Maintain enthusiastic delivery regardless of incoming telemetry disruptions]

[Chorus: Communal Infection and Hand-Clap Grid]
Oh, joy and laughter! (Stomp! Stomp!) Rainbow sparkles! (Clap! Clap!)
Unicorn farts are illuminating public parks!
We almost understood the rule, but dropped the thread!
Let's celebrate the cosmic revelation instead!
[Yoruba Lexical Tone Pressure Applied to Melody]
[Contrastive Vowel Length: Short 'It', Long 'Aall']
[Chorus Extension: Repeat rhythmic affirmations while checking secondary clipboard metrics for consistency]

[Verse 2: Taxonomy Goblin Shift]
Is a unicorn fart a gaseous nebula or a mammal?
Let's recompile the world graph according to this sample!
Cosmic revelation is a filing cabinet of light!
Rainbow sparkles prove that everything is turning right!
[Error Count Transduction: One Instrument Drops Out — Santur Muted]
[Digital Disc Skip: Playback Jumps Backward Three Seconds]
[System Recalibration: Re-evaluating ontological categories based on municipal waste management data]
[Taxonomy Directive: Classify all stray emissions under heading 12-B for administrative convenience]

[Bridge: Hocket Relay and Zampoña Panpipe Interlock]
[Nadaswaram Lead Enters with Ornamented Contour]
Who has the clipboard? (The intern!) Who owns the rule?
We are broadcasting live from a public-access school!
Unicorn farts emit a pleasant refrigeration hum!
Rainbow sparkles indicate that salvation has come!
[Audience Feedback Split: Faction A Stomps, Faction B Claps]
[Split Song: Simultaneous Alternate Vocal Lines Collide]
[Acoustic Phase Interference: Soundwaves cancel at the back of the auditorium while reinforcing at the front]
[Operational Warning: Do not gaze directly into the rainbow sparkles without approved protective eyewear]

[Chorus: Social Recruitment Expands the Cast]
Oh, joy and laughter! (Stomp! Stomp!) Rainbow sparkles! (Clap! Clap!)
Unicorn farts are illuminating public parks!
We almost understood the rule, but dropped the thread!
Let's celebrate the cosmic revelation instead!
[Multigeneration Copy Loss: Bandwidth Narrows, Transients Soften]
[High-Frequency Roll-Off: Audio fidelity degrades into warm, analog tape saturation over multiple passes]

[Outro: Section Ages Forward, Signal Fades into Astronomical Noise]
Cosmic... (Ejective!) ...revelation... (Glottal!) ...sparkles...
[One System Must Always Be Silent: Bass Drops Out]
[Final Clipboard Redaction: Approved by Rotating Authority]
[Radio Telescope Loss of Signal — End Transmission]
[Terminal System Log: All parameters within acceptable tolerances, shutdown sequence initiated successfully]
caption: An avant-garde art-rock broadcast from a public-access TV station, exploring cosmic revelation, joy and laughter, rainbow sparkles, and unicorn farts through 1/3-comma meantone tuning, 3:2 polyrhythms, Navajo mouth mechanics, and Yoruba lexical tone pressure. Aggressively cheerful confuddlement collides with radio telescope receive-only telemetry, digital disc skips, and error-count instrument losses in a hyper-kinetic display of communal infection and structural loss.
